author: Melissa Lee
text:
Can someone explain reactive hypoglycemia ? 
I was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes or technically now a history of since my A1C  is at 5.3 however there are times I eat glucose goes up not higher but 148-152 after 45 minutes or so then drops to the 50s . Not all the time but sometimes I’ve been trying to keep track of when it happens or if certain foods make it happen more than others .
